courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: Speaking of that, capacitor.ionicframework.com is a great place to dig deeper and to explore
all the possibilities this toolset gives you, how you can make it work with Cordova plugins.
Here you can also browse existing community plugins, if you scroll down to plugins, community plugins,
you see a list of plugins you could add to your application here, so that can be really helpful.
And at the bottom, you also see all the core APIs that already ship with Capacitor which you don't
have to install separately but which are in there already
and here you see the camera and the geolocation which are APIs we will use in this course module.
So definitely explore this documentation if you want to learn more
and if you want to use it in your next project, here I will give you a general overview and show you
two concrete examples, geolocation and the camera.
